info.name: Keel CRM - Complete Master API Collection (All Modules)
info.description:
Exhaustive, 100% complete Postman Collection covering EVERY SINGLE API endpoint across EVERY module of Keel Autonomous Agentic CRM.

### Modules Included:
1. **Core CRM & Pipeline Management**
   - Contacts (List, Search, Create, Lead Scoring)
   - Deals (List, Filter by Pipeline, Create Opportunity)
   - Companies & Accounts (List, Search, Create)
   - Unified Activities & Call Transcripts (List, Filter, Ingest with Idempotency & AI pass)
   - Tasks (List, Filter by Status, Create with Priority & Due Date)
   - Notes (List, Filter by Contact/Deal, Create)
   - Pipelines & Stages (List, Create Pipeline with Ordered Stages)
   - Tags & Custom Field Definitions (List, Create Custom Attributes)
   - Global CRM Search & Duplicate Detection/Merge
2. **Business OS & Revenue Operations**
   - Clients & Client Accounts (List, Search, Provision with Portal Token)
   - Quotations & Commercial Proposals (List, Filter, Create Quote)
   - Invoices (List, Filter Unpaid/Overdue, Issue Invoice)
   - Payments (List, Record Payment & Auto-Mark Invoice Paid)
   - Revenue Metrics (Aggregated Pipeline, Invoicing, & Collection KPIs)
   - Projects & Delivery Tracking (List, Create Project, Tasks & Deliverables)
   - Follow-ups (List, Schedule Multi-channel Follow-ups)
3. **Autonomous AI Agents & Agentic Memory**
   - Invoke Specialist Agents (`prospector`, `deal_doctor`, `guardian`, `copilot`)
   - Agent Run History & Audit Logs (List execution traces & tool invocations)
   - Human-in-the-Loop Action Queue (List pending items, Approve/Reject)
   - Long-Term Agentic Memory (Query & Upsert persistent key-values)
   - Agent Configuration (Get & Update execution mode, intervals, models)
4. **Generative AI & Copilot Engine**
   - Copilot Chat Assistant (Context-aware CRM copilot)
   - Business Insights Narrative (KPI analysis & recommendations)
   - Proposal Quote Line Item Generator (AI quotation engine)
   - Follow-up Suggestion Drafter (AI WhatsApp/Email drafts)
   - Conversation Thread Summarizer
5. **Vertical Industry Modules**
   - Logistics & Freight Shipments (Booking, ETA, Carrier tracking)
   - Fintech & KYC Compliance (Regulatory documents, Status checks)
   - Appointments & Service Booking (Scheduling, Time slots)
   - E-Commerce & Wholesale Orders (Fulfillment, Line summaries)
   - Real Estate Properties (Listings, Pricing, Tenant/Buyer assignment)
6. **Developer Platform, Webhooks & Governance**
   - Outbound Webhooks (List, Register with Signing Secret)
   - Inbound Payment Webhook (Auto-transition deal to Won & fan out webhooks)
   - Workflow Automations (List, Create trigger-condition-action rules)
   - Scoped API Keys (List, Generate new keys)
   - Audit Logs & Security Trails
   - Notification Center
   - Team Management (List, Add team members)
   - OpenAPI 3.1 Live Spec
7. **Background Sweeps & Cron Workers**
   - Agent Sweep Engine (POST / GET)
   - Due-Date & Overdue Invoices / Followups Sweep Engine
8. **Omnichannel Messaging & Client Portal**
   - Outbound WhatsApp & Email Sender
   - Client Portal Inbound Message & Automated Partner Reply
9. **Authentication & Session (NextAuth)**
   - Session, CSRF Token, Providers, Credentials Sign-in, Sign-out
